part.text:
The `pagesfromdata` failure is environmental (`asciidoctor not found in $PATH`), unrelated to the change. All markup and blockquote tests pass.

**Fix:** Made the GitHub alert regex case-insensitive in markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go:274 by adding the `(?i)` flag, so `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, `[!nOtE]` etc. are now recognized, with the alert type still normalized to lowercase via `strings.ToLower`.
